name: Whitehall School District
quote: Expulsion Suspension Detention, including Saturday school Clean-up duty Loss of student privileges Loss of bus privileges Notification to juvenile authorities and/or police Restitution for damages to school property No District employee or person engaged by the District may inflict or cause to be inflicted corporal punishment on a student.
